text: Swimming is a fun and healthy way to stay active. To start, you can do laps, which means swimming in a circle. This helps build your strength and speed. After that, you can wear goggles, which are special swimming glasses that keep your eyes protected while you swim. They come in many different colors and styles to choose from. So, if you want to swim and have fun, just remember to do laps first and wear goggles later!
